text_block_list.text:
The "Summer Training Camp" starts today!
Intensive training begins to level up our abilities.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Hawawa, what should I do?
Rice actually came to the training camp...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
With so many other Umamusume around...
If Rice brings misfortune upon them—
choice_data_list: That's not what you should be thinking about right now, okay?
That's not what you should be thinking about right now, is it?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best so I can catch up to Bourbon in the next Kikuka Sho... right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe...
I was just stating my goal, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, all right... Let's do our best
at the training camp too. You can do it, Rice...!

And so, summer training camp
with Rice Shower began!!
